title: Business Gold Rewards Card: What Qualifies as Operations Spend?
summary: This document explains what qualifies as “operations spend” for the Business Gold Rewards Card to earn 2.5%: utilities/telecom, cloud services & software subscriptions, shipping/postage/logistics, office supplies/routine maintenance, and professional services (e.g., bookkeeping or payroll admin). It also explains that merchant category codes assigned by the payment processor determine eligibility, lists cash-like, peer-to-peer transfers, debt repayments, and entertainment/personal/non-business use as non-qualifying, and provides steps to avoid or fix misclassification.
